summary: Templated operator() overload calls (t(5), t<uint>(5), t.operator()<uint>(5)) all still error on main (89e2f98e2); bisect shows always-repro'd from v1.6.2112 (the oldest release that can even parse -HV 2021) through v1.9.2607, so this predates the report and was never implemented, not a regression. The successor hlsl_clang_trunk front end already accepts the two C++-legal forms (t(5), t.operator()<uint>(5)) in isolation and only rejects t<uint>(5), which is not valid C++ syntax either -- matching real C++ overload rules on this input, though unshipped in a DXC release.
title: Impossible to add template on operator() overload
